findings.title: Malformed diagnostic coordinates rendered NaN
fact: The existing file-tool component keeper observed locations [1:1] and [NaN:NaN] with the incomplete start coordinate story arg.
The same keeper passed after validating the consumed diagnostic projection.
findings.hypothesis: The prior shallow guard admitted a range object without its numeric start coordinates.

inference.relation: The DOM failure is caused by a diagnostic accepted without finite line/character; rendering adds one to each missing coordinate.

findings.recommendation: Use the existing Schema boundary to decode message/severity/start coordinates, preserve severity=1, source order and top-three selection; no range.end requirement.

findings.title: Step cleanup aborted deferred external results during restart
fact: The existing MC06-R1 keeper retained a suspended claimed parent with an unread external result; after resumeSuspendedSessions its original Task Tool was error/aborted.
Deleting the early cleanup made the external keeper pass but the five-file replay failed two original SQLite attempt/Goal recovery keepers.
The final owner-first cleanup passed the complete five-file replay, 254/0/2234.
findings.hypothesis: Generic Step cleanup ran before durable Delegation ownership could establish that the parent must be deferred.

inference.relation: reconcile emits Tool.Failed for unsettled tools.
recoverPending decides deferredChildren/deferredParents; cleanup now excludes those and active Sessions before Goal recovery.

findings.recommendation: Recover durable tool owners first, clean eligible suspended Sessions, then recover Goals; retain cleanup before a permitted actual resume.

findings.title: Operation attachment reordered Tasks after deletion gaps
fact: The existing attachment keeper failed full public Task IDs after appending four Tasks and deleting the first two.
The final full Task service file passed as part of the five-file 254/0 replay.
findings.hypothesis: Using live row count as the append position places the new Task before the retained largest position.

inference.relation: read sorts Task rows by position.
removeTask deletes without normalizing retained positions.
ordinary append already uses largest retained position plus one.

findings.recommendation: Reuse the existing ordinary append position rule in attachOperationTask; preserve lock, transaction, claims and exact retry.

findings.title: Early drawer close retained modal ownership without a transform completion event
fact: Original Composer component suite failed two focus-return keepers.

Original-timing lifecycle probe reproduced one failure: focus was inside drawer at Escape; afterward trigger closed, content reached the closed 162px transform, but data-open/data-closing and default focus remained with no transitionend.
Frozen package installation succeeded with unchanged dependency version; exact patch replay of baseline JS/JSX exports matches installed bytes.
Complete Composer keeper after repair: 19 passed, actual exit 0; single Escape timing retained and modal-hidden outcome added.
findings.hypothesis: The Drawer closing owner relied on a transform transitionend even when the opening paint had not created an actual transition.

inference.relation: The early-close modal survived at its closed endpoint; waiting for initial focus is contradicted by the event-time focus observation.
Installed DrawerRoot closes transitionAwareOpen only on transitionend or zero declared duration; delayed opening/closing callbacks also lack current-intent guards.

findings.recommendation: Guard delayed callbacks by current open intent and invoke original closeDrawer when no direct running/pending transform CSSTransition exists. Preserve original event completion when an actual transform transition exists.

technicalDebt.unlock: Upgrade to an upstream fix, remove this patch, then replay the existing Composer fast Escape/hidden/focus keeper.

sc03Acceptance.authorization: 用户答复：根据协议的文本内容和第一性原理来选择吧；允许据此定案、可逆验证与精确暂存。

fact.observation: 原协议明确一次绝对 dueAt 或 recurrence＋IANA timezone，未直接定义二者同时传入时的首次优先级。
dueAt 在提醒合同中定义为绝对到期时间；Create/Edit 同时允许 dueAt 与 recurrence，未定义 startAt/notBefore。
原 dueAfter 在 recurrence.enabled 时取 next cron；创建、pending edit 与 resume 使用它，认领时按固定 scheduledAt 推进后续周期。

hypothesis.consequence: 会引入一次不满足 cron 的计划触发，原文本没有定义这项额外执行。
保留 cron 网格，但需新增 dueAt=notBefore 的组合模式假设，会改变首期和期次身份集合。

hypothesis.choice: enabled recurrence 选择周期触发模式
hypothesis.consequence: 采用原文的两种触发方式；dueAt 在一次性模式生效，周期模式使用 cron。

inference.step: “dueAt 或 recurrence”支持按 recurrence.enabled 选择触发模式；它不能单独推出首次混合输入优先级，故本次显式补充。
旧字段分别映射 scheduledAt→一次 dueAt、enabled recurrence→cron/timezone。下界需给一次到期时间新增起始角色；本次保持原角色。
现有 UI 创建使用互斥触发输入、编辑一次性规则显式移除 recurrence，通用 API/CLI/Tool 转发 Schema；未发现起始下界约定。

recommendation.rule: recurrence.enabled=true 时，首次及后续按 cron＋时区。dueAt 不作首次覆盖或下界；关闭或移除 recurrence 后按保存的 dueAt 一次执行。
recommendation.implementation: 复用原 Schedule owner；本次生产实现没有改动。
recommendation.scope: 创建、pending edit、resume、精确重试、后续 occurrence、关闭/移除 recurrence；手动 run 与既有错过周期策略按原合同。

alternativesDecision.basis: 协议的两种触发方式和 dueAt 的绝对到期角色；无需新增组合模式或状态。
alternativesDecision.independentSecondOpinion: 独立读者最初建议下界；复核确认它依赖新增 notBefore 假设，最终支持按现文本选择 cron 优先。
alternativesDecision.acceptedExistingTradeoff: 保留双可选字段的兼容 wire shape；触发优先级由原 owner 和可执行 keeper 判定，类型本身不区分两触发模式。改成 tagged union 会改动公开 payload 与消费面，本次没有对应迁移需求。
